fields.description: How often the background poller refreshes data from every connected Proxmox server.
fields.label: Poll Interval (seconds)

fields.description: Any CPU, RAM, or storage reading at or above this percentage — but below the Critical Threshold — is flagged Warning once it's stayed at or above this line for Confirmation Checks below.
fields.label: Warning Threshold (%)

fields.description: Any CPU, RAM, or storage reading at or above this percentage is flagged Critical once it's stayed at or above this line for Confirmation Checks below.
fields.label: Critical Threshold (%)

fields.description: How many consecutive polls a reading must stay at or above the Warning/Critical Threshold, with no dip below it, before that alert fires. A single dip below the threshold resets the count — it does not carry over partial progress. Applies to both tiers.
fields.label: Confirmation Checks

fields.description: Uses the Email Account already configured in core Frappe (Settings > Email Account). No separate SMTP config here.
fields.label: Enable Email Alerts

fields.description: Requires a Telegram integration app (e.g. frappe_telegram) installed and configured with its own bot token — this app never stores the bot token.
fields.label: Enable Telegram Alerts

fields.description: The chat/group ID the configured Telegram bot should send alerts to.
fields.label: Telegram Chat ID

fields.description: Requires the frappe_whatsapp app installed and configured with its own WhatsApp Cloud API credentials — this app never stores those credentials.
fields.label: Enable WhatsApp Alerts

fields.description: Comma-separated list of WhatsApp numbers in international format, e.g. 919812345678.
fields.label: WhatsApp Recipients

fields.description: The WhatsApp Templates document name (or its Template Name) for a Meta-approved UTILITY template with exactly one body variable, which will receive the alert text. Required for WhatsApp alerts to send — without it, WhatsApp is treated as not configured and skipped.
fields.label: WhatsApp Template Name

fields.description: A separate Meta-approved UTILITY template for "back to normal" recovery notifications (Critical Resource and Server Offline only) — kept distinct from the alert template above so a resolved-condition message doesn't reuse the alert's framing. If unset, WhatsApp recovery notifications are skipped (Email/Telegram recovery still send).
fields.label: WhatsApp Recovery Template Name
